title: [physics:P0] Surface simulate instability (metrics + gates in App)
body:
## Context
Tracked from `docs/physics-engine-release-review.md`.

`solveWithForce` always returns `converged: true` / `residual: 0` (`src/core/solver/newton-raphson.ts`). The simulate tick cannot distinguish stable vs exploding states.

## Goal
- Compute a lightweight stability metric each frame (e.g. max |Δposition| per substep, max velocity, post-projection constraint violation).
- Return it from `solveWithForce`; handle in `src/App.tsx` (warn UI, clamp, or auto-pause above thresholds).

## Acceptance
Simulate visibly fails safe (user feedback) under stiff springs + high sim speed rather than silently zooming joints off-screen.

title: [physics:P0] Motor playback: tie time/driver advance to kinematic convergence
body:
## Context
From physics release review (`docs/physics-engine-release-review.md`).

In create mode with motor, when `solve` does not converge, `advanceTime` / driver angle may still advance while `moveJoint` commits are skipped (`src/App.tsx`). That desyncs the timeline UI from geometry.

## Goal
If `solve` fails to converge:
- either **do not advance** simulated time/driver angle that frame,
- or pause + show explicit **kinematics not solved** state.

## Acceptance
No silent playback where crank clock moves but mechanism pose does not.
Refs: `newton-raphson.ts` `solve`, motor tick in `App.tsx`.

title: [physics:P0] Reject non-finite joint state after solver; optional rewind
body:
## Context
From `docs/physics-engine-release-review.md`.

There is limited validation before `solveWithForce`; NaN/infinite coords can propagate into stores and corrupt rendering (`renderer/draw-mechanism.ts`).

## Goal
- After each solve / tick, validate joint positions.
- If non-finite: skip commit **or** restore last-good snapshot + `resetVelocities()` (`newton-raphson.ts`).

## Acceptance
Malformed numeric state cannot persist across frames unchecked.

title: [physics:P1] Unify solver tuning (SolverConfig + constants vs literals)
body:
## Context
`SOLVER_MAX_ITERATIONS`, `SOLVER_TOLERANCE` live in `src/utils/constants.ts`, but `solveWithForce` also hardcodes substep counts, constraint passes, friction, epsilons in `src/core/solver/newton-raphson.ts`. `SolverConfig` in `src/types/solver.ts` is not wired through the API.

## Goal
Single configuration surface (typed) passed into `solve` / `solveWithForce`; remove magic numbers where practical.

## Acceptance
Tuning knobs documented in one place; no duplicate conflicting defaults.
Tracked: `docs/physics-engine-release-review.md` §P1.

title: [physics:P1] Motor driver: validate topology and surface actionable errors
body:
## Context
If the driver link has no endpoint on the base/fixed body, driver IDs can be missing and the motor tick bails quietly (`src/App.tsx`).

## Goal
User-visible diagnostics when driver setup is ambiguous (toast, inline panel, console is not enough for release).

## Acceptance
Invalid driver configs never silently no-op.
Refs: physics review driver risk table.
Tracked: `docs/physics-engine-release-review.md`.

title: [physics:P1] Torsion: rename equilibrium helper + tighten property/help copy
body:
## Context
`equilibriumRestLength` is overloaded for linear rest length vs torsion equilibrium angle semantics (`spring-solver.ts`, `spring-forces.ts`). Property/tooltips risk misleading users (`restLength` / `prestress` differ by spring kind).

## Goal
- Split naming (e.g. `equilibriumRestAngle`) or document clearly inline.
- Update property panel / docs strings.

Tracked: `docs/physics-engine-release-review.md` §P1 items 6 + springs risk table.

title: [physics:P2] Stabilize stiff springs under large effective dt
body:
## Context
Explicit substeps + PBD projection fights stiff SI springs especially when sim speed scales `dt` (`App.tsx`).

## Goal
Evaluate stiffness-aware substeps, caps on `sim.speed * dt`, and/or heavier implicit or XPBD-style handling for stiff segments.

Long-horizon; link to instability metrics issue when implemented.
Tracked: physics review §P2 item 7.

title: [physics:P2] Regularize zero-length linear springs / anchors
body:
## Context
`linearSpringAccelerationOnB` returns no force below length threshold (<1e–12)—overlapping anchors never self-separate (`src/core/springs/spring-forces.ts`).

## Goal
Small directional regularization or stable fallback behavior (document tradeoffs).

Tracked: `docs/physics-engine-release-review.md` springs table.

title: [physics:P2] Document joint mass vs spring acceleration model
body:
## Context
Types may expose link mass while springs accelerate joint DOFs under a heuristic unit-mass framing — mismatch confuses fidelity expectations and UI labels (`docs/physics-engine-release-review.md` §P2).

## Goal
Either document the effective model in-repo or align implementation with advertised mass semantics.

Tracked: physics review backlog item 9.

title: [ux:P3] Simulation tick errors: toast/banner + auto-pause path
body:
## Context
`App.tsx` tick `try/catch` logs errors only (≠ user-visible).

## Goal
Recoverable UX: toast or banner + optional auto-pause of playback on thrown errors.

Tracked: physics review §P3 item 10 + integration risks.

title: [ux:P3] Force overlays and readouts: model units vs SI
body:
## Context
`src/utils/units.ts` describes displayed "N" as scaled internal PBD-derived values; users may over-trust numbers.

## Goal
UI copy overlays / property inspector matches actual scaling; link to solver/force-analysis behavior.

Tracked: physics review §P3 item 11 + integration table.

title: [ux:P3] Optional solver timing / FPS diagnostic overlay
body:
## Context
Heavy mechanisms + fixed `dt` can drop wall-clock frame rate while still stepping simulation — hard to diagnose without timings.

## Goal
Dev or optional overlay: solver ms / tick duration.

Tracked: physics review §P3 item 12.

title: [tests] Add regressions for `solve` motor + NR kinematic path
body:
## Context
Most automated tests exercise `solveWithForce` (`physics-integration.test.ts`, `test-scenarios.ts`). The `solve()` path lacks parity coverage (singularities, max iterations, DOF).

## Goal
Vitest fixtures for crank/motor setups; assert convergence + pose vs known geometry tolerances.

Refs: `src/core/solver/newton-raphson.ts`, `dof.ts`, `driver.ts`
Tracked: physics review §Test gaps bullet 1.

title: [tests] Link-anchored springs + stiffness stress harness
body:
## Context
`accumulateLinearSpringAccelerations` supports link midpoints ('split' / resolveAnchor paths); Vitest suites skew joint–joint.
Stress: high stiffness × `sim.speed` × `dt`, bounded displacement.

## Goal
- Tests for springs anchored via link + `t`
- Regression with extreme parameters + motion bounds

Refs: `spring-solver.ts`; physics review §Test gaps.

title: [tests] Torsion angles: wrap near +/- pi, torsion SI mappers
body:
## Context
Torsion skips torque on collapsed legs; wrap/prestress edge cases untested. `siTorsionStiffnessToSim` / `siTorsionDampingToSim` lacking tests vs linear mappers (`spring-forces.test.ts`).

## Goal
Targeted Vitest modules for equilibrium angle + wrap + mapper round-trips.

Refs: `spring-solver.ts`, `spring-forces.ts`
Tracked: physics review §Test gaps.

title: [tests] Integration: switchMode / regenerateLinks / colliderSides / SOLVER_MAX_ITERS motor
body:
## Context
Mode transitions mutate topology/rest lengths; colliderSidesRef rebuild semantics; NR max-iter failure during motor lacks automated coverage (`App.tsx`, `mechanism-store.ts`, `mode-switch.ts`).

## Goal
Integration-style tests capturing ordering invariants.
Acceptance: regression PRs touching mode switch or collide init stay safe.

Tracked: physics review §Test gaps final bullet.

title: [maint] Constraint cleanup: audit `onAxisConstraint` vs sliders
body:
## Context
`onAxisConstraint` in `constraints.ts` may be unused by `solve`/`solveWithForce` (sliders projected ad hoc elsewhere). Maintainability risk.

## Goal
Repo-wide usages; wire in, deprecate/remove, or document why kept.

Tracked: physics review solver risk table (`onAxisConstraint`).
Tracked: appendix D in prior solver agent notes (`docs/physics-engine-release-review.md` cites dead helper risk).

title: [physics] Dual damping UX: clarify global vs spring damper knobs
body:
## Context
`solveWithForce` applies global retention damping per substep *and* per-spring damping coefficients mapped from SI (`spring-solver.ts` / `newton-raphson.ts`). Easy to confuse in UI/copy.

## Goal
Property panel docs + sane defaults naming ≈ "global damping" vs "element damping."

Tracked: physics review springs table (dual damping).
Tracked: springs agent summary.

title: [physics:P1-b] Pre-solve sanity checks before `solveWithForce`
body:
## Context
No guard for degenerate/zero-length links, NaN poses, dangling slider/collider refs entering the timestep (`physics-engine-release-review.md` Integration table).

## Goal
Early validation with structured skip or warning (ties into finite-position guard).

May merge with `[physics:P0] Reject non-finite` — coordinate during implementation.
Tracked: physics-engine-release-review §Integration failures.
